NORTHWIND LABS, INC. 
1201 Western Avenue, Seattle, WA 98101 
October 20, 2026 
Dear Jordan Lee, 
On behalf of Northwind Labs, Inc., I am delighted to offer you the position of Senior Product Designer
on our Design Platform team. This is a full-time, exempt position reporting to Priya Raman, Director of
Design. Northwind Labs is a Series C company, and we believe you will play a key role in our next
stage of growth. 
Compensation. Your annual base salary will be $195,000, paid semi-monthly in accordance with our
standard payroll practices. You will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus with a target of
15% of your base salary, based on individual and company performance. 
Equity. Subject to approval by the Board of Directors, you will be granted restricted stock units (RSUs)
with an approximate value of $120,000, vesting over four years with a one-year cliff. 
Work location. This is a hybrid role based in our Seattle, WA office, with an expectation of three days
per week in the office. 
Benefits. You will be eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with a 4% company
match, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, and a $1,500 annual learning stipend. You will receive 20 days
of paid time off per year, plus company holidays. 
Start date. Your anticipated start date is December 1, 2026. 
This offer is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Please sign and return this
letter by October 27, 2026. We are excited about the possibility of you joining the team. 
Sincerely, 
Priya Raman, Director of Design, Northwind Labs, Inc.
